# FAIR research software assessment

**Status: provisional advisory; not independently accepted.**

The `howfairis` GitHub Action reports five public repository metadata signals (source access, licence, software registry, citation, quality checklist) from a SHA-pinned implementation. A green workflow is **not** FAIR4RS certification, a validated ARDC self-assessment, scientific reproducibility or a release gate.

Record the evaluated default-branch revision, hosted run URL, actual five-point results, evidence for repository and third-party licences, authorship and `CITATION.cff`, package registry/DOI, concrete QA checklist, and each [ARDC FAIR checklist](https://github.com/ardc-fair-checklist/ardc-fair-checklist.github.io) answer. Unknown claims remain unknown; do not invent badges, registrations, rights or releases.

Existing source rights, privacy, security, provenance, integration tests, Conductor and publication controls remain authoritative. Reuse [repository-standards optional FAIR policy](https://github.com/edithatogo/repository-standards/blob/main/docs/fair-research-software-standard.md).

DigitalNZ collections are third-party heritage data. Public client code does not confer redistribution rights over API responses or source collections.
